baseline_description: Latest GitHub main and Sites application source from last night; preserve all current application files and published data.
older_ui: Archive only; do not cherry-pick old UI work or apply an old stash wholesale.
content: Review by record, source and quote before integration or push. Preserve current IDs, corrected passages, scope limits, topics and references.
stories: Keep current stories unless a documented comparison establishes that an older candidate is better. Do not prefer older text just because it is longer.
git_practice: Alert the owner about stale branches, dirty-tree pulls, divergent histories and destructive or overwriting operations. Use fast-forward updates when histories allow.
publication: No cleanup or candidate branch is approved for publication. No push or deployment is part of this cleanup.
automation: Claude control files and scheduled tasks are unchanged. Completed uncommitted drafts are preserved on this local review branch; future integrations must check this branch and the archived stashes, not only main.

people_stash.disposition: hold-pending-content-review; UI and importer changes are not applied

old_evidence_stash.disposition: historical archive only; do not restore removed Science Agrees records or replace the larger current catalog
